requirements.title: MERGE_BITS admits integer and bounded BOZ argument forms
requirements.definition: I, J, and MASK may be integer arguments, and a BOZ literal constant is admitted for any one side where the restrictions allow it.

pending.MERGE_BITS-I-integer-or-BOZ-admitted: Use BOZ literal I=B"1100", integer J, and integer MASK in a positive control; assert the result bit pattern with BTEST and POPCNT. Mutate I to the corresponding integer literal in a companion to keep the BOZ path load-bearing through source coverage.
pending.MERGE_BITS-J-integer-or-BOZ-admitted: Use integer I, BOZ literal J=B"1010", and integer MASK in a positive control; assert the result bit pattern with BTEST and POPCNT. Mutate J to the corresponding integer literal in a companion to keep the BOZ path load-bearing through source coverage.
pending.MERGE_BITS-MASK-integer-or-BOZ-admitted: Use integer I and J with BOZ literal MASK=B"0101"; assert selected low-order bits with BTEST and POPCNT. Mutate the mask literal to B"0011" so the bit-context oracle changes.

requirements.title: MERGE_BITS argument restrictions
requirements.definition: I and J shall be integer or BOZ, integer I and J shall have the same kind, I and J shall not both be BOZ literals, and integer MASK shall have the same kind as each other integer argument.

pending.MERGE_BITS-I-J-type-or-BOZ: Positive source controls use integer/integer, BOZ/integer, and integer/BOZ pairs; source-control mutations use real arguments and claim no diagnostic facet.
pending.MERGE_BITS-integer-I-J-same-kind: Positive source controls use same-kind integer I and J; a source-control mutation gives I and J different integer kinds and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.MERGE_BITS-I-J-not-both-BOZ: Positive source controls use exactly one BOZ among I and J; a source-control mutation makes both I and J BOZ literals and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.MERGE_BITS-MASK-type-or-BOZ: Positive source controls use integer MASK and BOZ MASK; a source-control mutation uses logical MASK and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.MERGE_BITS-integer-MASK-same-kind: Positive source controls use same-kind integer I, J, and MASK; a source-control mutation varies only MASK kind and claims no diagnostic facet.

requirements.title: MERGE_BITS result kind follows the integer source argument
requirements.definition: The MERGE_BITS result has the same type and kind as I for integer I, otherwise the same type and kind as J.

pending.MERGE_BITS-result-kind-from-I: Evaluate MERGE_BITS with integer I of default kind and BOZ MASK, initialize an integer result sentinel, and assert KIND(result)==KIND(I) plus bit-context value checks; mutate I kind in source review so the kind assertion changes.
pending.MERGE_BITS-result-kind-from-J-with-BOZ-I: Guarded plan probes an available nondefault integer kind for J, uses BOZ I with that J, and asserts KIND(result)==KIND(J) plus bit-context value checks; fallback default-kind control keeps the BOZ-I path covered without a nondefault-kind claim.

requirements.title: MERGE_BITS converts BOZ operands and merges bit selections
requirements.definition: BOZ literal arguments are converted as by INT to the result type and kind, and the result value is IOR(IAND(I,MASK), IAND(J,NOT(MASK))).

pending.MERGE_BITS-BOZ-converted-as-INT: Use actual BOZ literals for I and MASK in separate controls and assert identical BTEST/POPCNT observations to integer controls produced with INT on the same BOZ literals; mutate one BOZ digit so the bit observations fail.
pending.MERGE_BITS-I-bits-selected-by-MASK: For I=B"1100", J=B"1010", MASK=B"0101", assert bit 2 of the result is true because it comes from I under a set mask bit; mutate MASK to clear that bit.
pending.MERGE_BITS-J-bits-selected-by-NOT-MASK: For I=B"1100", J=B"1010", MASK=B"0101", assert bit 1 of the result is true because it comes from J under a clear mask bit; mutate J to clear that bit.
pending.MERGE_BITS-result-bit-expression: For the same operands assert POPCNT(result)==3 and selected low-order BTEST outcomes matching B"1110", never a sign-bit numeric value; mutate MERGE_BITS to IOR so the mixed mask differs.
